response.sql: SELECT sc.zoneref, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scanconservation sc2 INNER JOIN sites s2 ON sc2.zoneref = s2.zoneregistry) AS fraction FROM scanconservation sc INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY sc.zoneref, s.insurstat ORDER BY fraction DESC, s.insurstat IS NULL, sc.zoneref, s.insurstat LIMIT 10;

alternatives.interpretation: The fraction denominator is the total count of all conservation records in the database (not just matched ones), expressing each group's count as a fraction of all conservation records regardless of site-matching status.
alternatives.sql: SELECT sc.zoneref, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scanconservation) AS fraction FROM scanconservation sc INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY sc.zoneref, s.insurstat ORDER BY fraction DESC, s.insurstat IS NULL, sc.zoneref, s.insurstat LIMIT 10;
